## Outcome and scope

State the concrete result and boundaries. Search existing open and closed issues first.
Split independently deliverable work into linked issues.

## Authority and constraints

Link relevant design or evidence. Record dependencies and any separately required decisions.
Keep private infrastructure and sensitive client work in rustia-ops.

## Acceptance

List observable completion checks, required tests/evidence and documentation updates.

## Related work and progress

Link parent/follow-up issues and existing PRs. Record branch/PR and progress when work begins.
